evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep never asked "Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?" or equivalent. Jumped directly into logistics probing after quido pro quo.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — customer raised no concerns during the call.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — customer raised no concerns during the call.

Phone number and confirmation email mentioned but details to be verified by customer via email response, not confirmed live on call. top_strength: Jules thoroughly gathered logistics details, item-by-item, leveraging prior move history to probe intelligently for what would travel and what wouldn't, and provided a clear, anchored estimate with transparent hourly and fee structure.
coaching_note: Jules skipped Section 2 entirely (never asked "Other than price, what are your biggest concerns?"), skipped both promises (On-Time Guarantee and Damage Coverage), never asked a final concerns check, and jumped to booking without an explicit ask—all critical framework items that build trust and protect the sale.
